bank.title: Draft a reply in your own tone, then make it yours
bank.hook: A tricky email sits in your inbox because you cannot find the right tone.
bank.problem: A first draft in the right tone is quicker to edit than a blank page.
steps: Paste the email you received (no customer data) and say what you want to happen.
Give two or three words for the tone, such as 'warm, brief, firm'.
Edit the draft until it sounds like you, then send it yourself.
bank.prompt: Here is an email I received: [paste]. Write a short reply that does this: [your aim]. Tone: [warm, brief, firm]. Do not promise anything I have not listed here: [list].
checks: It promises nothing you did not agree to.
Names, dates and figures match the original email.
bank.privacy: Do not paste customer or company data into an AI tool.
